{
  "feasibility": {
    "verdict": "feasible",
    "answerable": [
      "Elevation-resolved partitioning of precipitation into evapotranspiration, surface/subsurface runoff, and snowpack storage/melt along the Bow River headwaters gradient",
      "Snow accumulation and ablation timing (SWE) as a function of elevation",
      "Relative shift from rain- to snow-dominated water balance with increasing elevation"
    ],
    "not_answerable": [
      "Direct validation against SNOTEL (US-only network, absent in Canada)",
      "Basin-integrated streamflow routing/hydrographs (single-column ELM has no lateral routing; ECCC gauge data not in stack)",
      "Glacier mass balance at the highest peaks (ELM lacks a dynamic glacier module)"
    ]
  },
  "n_columns": 5,
  "n_justification": "The scientific driver is elevation (2200 m span, 1200-3400 m). Five columns sample the gradient at ~550 m intervals to resolve the transition from valley-bottom rain-dominated regime to alpine snow-dominated regime, capturing the elevation control on snow fraction, ET, and runoff partitioning while remaining computationally tractable for a single-column campaign.",
  "columns": [
    {"id": "bow_1250m_valley", "lat": 51.05, "lon": -114.60, "soil_texture": "loam"},
    {"id": "bow_1750m_montane", "lat": 51.10, "lon": -115.00, "soil_texture": "sandy_loam"},
    {"id": "bow_2300m_subalpine", "lat": 51.20, "lon": -115.30, "soil_texture": "sandy_loam"},
    {"id": "bow_2850m_alpine", "lat": 51.30, "lon": -115.45, "soil_texture": "loamy_sand"},
    {"id": "bow_3300m_nival", "lat": 51.35, "lon": -115.55, "soil_texture": "loamy_sand"}
  ],
  "elm_config": {
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_START": "1980",
    "DATM_CLMNCEP_YR_END": "2018",
    "STOP_N": "39",
    "RUN_STARTDATE": "1980-01-01",
    "hist_variables": [
      "RAIN",
      "SNOW",
      "QOVER",
      "QDRAI",
      "QRUNOFF",
      "QINFL",
      "QSNOMELT",
      "H2OSNO",
      "SNOWDP",
      "FSNO",
      "QVEGT",
      "QVEGE",
      "QSOIL",
      "EFLX_LH_TOT",
      "SOILLIQ",
      "SOILICE",
      "TSA",
      "TSOI",
      "ZWT"
    ]
  },
  "requires_capabilities": [
    "GSWP3 global atmospheric forcing (1980-2018) with elevation-based lapse-rate downscaling of temperature/precip (NLDAS excluded, CONUS-only)",
    "ELM snow physics (multi-layer snowpack, SNICAR)",
    "Single-column point-mode configuration (I-compset, e.g. I1850ELMCN or ICLM45)"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "GSWP3 forcing is applied with atmospheric elevation adjustment (hgt-based lapse rate) so that high columns receive colder/snowier forcing consistent with their assigned elevation",
    "First 3 years (1980-1982) treated as spin-up; analysis focuses on 1983-2018 for stable soil moisture and snow states",
    "Vegetation follows default surface dataset PFT distribution (needleleaf evergreen forest at montane/subalpine, bare/alpine tundra at high elevation)",
    "No lateral flow or glacier dynamics; each column is an independent 1-D water balance",
    "ECCC gauge comparison, if desired, would be qualitative only since no routing is performed"
  ]
}

Snow accumulation and ablation timing (SWE) as a function of elevation
Relative shift from rain- to snow-dominated water balance with increasing elevation
not_answerable: Direct validation against SNOTEL (US-only network, absent in Canada)
